issues.en: Father's name 'Павна' (probably Paweł) kept as read. Baptism day 'двод цать девятаго' read as 29th. Entry text reads Раудонисовъ, margin Гаудонисовъ: treated as one surname, margin form used. Stray characters at the end of the godparents line ('ЮЗПК в. а4 768-').
